STATUS: ANSWER
Two tools in the context check whether samples come from the same individual. NGSCheckMate uses a set of commonly heterozygous SNPs to detect sample mislabelling. Its output lists matched comparisons with correlation and a dendrogram [sarek_output#h066]. bcftools gtcheck checks sample identity: with -g, samples in the query VCF are checked against the samples in the -g file; without -g, all samples in the query file are cross-checked [bcftools_manual#h057]. Pairs can be selected with -p or -P, and --n-matches limits the output to the top matches [bcftools_manual#h059]. The discordance score counts mismatching genotypes only for GT-vs-GT matching [bcftools_manual#h057]. The context does not give a cutoff for deciding that two samples match.
